senses.gloss: the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:9">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיבּוֹ של אילן</he> ed. (Ar. a. Ms. <he>חובו</he>, v. <cite ref="H00234"><he>חוֹב</he> II</cite>, cmp. Rashi a. l.). [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:3:4">Y. Erub. III, 21ᵃ</cite> top <he>איבו</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 2:4:5">Y. Succ. II, 53ᵃ</cite> <he>צידו</he>.]
Ḥull. 58ᵃ cascuta which became wormy באִבֶּיהָ during its growth.

<cite ref="Chullin 127b">Ib. 127ᵇ</cite> figs which shrunk <he>באִבֵּיהֶן</he> during development. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ bot. he who presses olives <he>מאִבֵּיהֶן</he> from where they grow (before they are ripe to be taken off). [<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:4">Tosef. Maasr. I, 4</cite> <he>איבין אדומים</he>, Var. <he>אובין</he>, read <he>אוּגִין</he>, v. <cite ref="A00535"><he>אוֹג</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:5">Ib. 5</cite> they differ <he>על האיבין</he> concerning the plants in their growing state (between ripening [<he>גמר</he>] and blossoming [<he>הנץ</he>]; Var. <cite ref="A00743"><he>אוֹנין</he></cite> incorr.); cmp. <he>יָבַן</he>. Ch. v. <cite ref="A01117"><he>אִיבָּא</he> I</cite>.
